sources.fact: LBBD94/HS Former White Horse Pub, Chadwell Heath is 0.31ha, 104 net dwellings, deliverable and permissioned.
Current Brownfield record gives full planning permission date 31 July 2024 and 104 minimum/maximum net dwellings.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry; point is not the planning red-line or HMLR title polygon.
Ownership status not-owned-by-a-public-authority does not identify proprietor or title number.
22/01757/FULL is the former White Horse redevelopment application; committee delegated grant subject to Mayor/S106/conditions.
Main application scope is residential-led mixed use with replacement public house; later register evidence records 104 homes.
25/01215/VAR is a Section 73 minor-material-amendment application concerning the previously granted White Horse permission.
The varied proposal retains 104 residential dwellings with flexible commercial/community space.
December 2025 committee resolution required legal agreement completion or further delegated action; this wave does not infer final Section 73 issue from committee resolution alone.
Published December 2025 committee minutes confirm the 25/01215/VAR consideration and 104-home scope.
Case-specific current decision status requires exact planning-register evidence.
Brownfield status/capacity evidence is kept separate from exact HMLR parcel/title and executed statutory-overlay evidence.
